description: List all ChangeGamer resources with metadata and absolute URLs. Returns slug, title, description, category, tags, updated date, premium flag, and HTML/Markdown/JSON variant URLs. No body content. Optional `category` and `premium` filters narrow the list; without them every resource is returned.

category.description: Only resources in this category (case-insensitive): Guide, Policy, Reference, Meta.

premium.description: true = only premium resources, false = only free ones.

name: list_resources
title: List resources
